name: switch
title: Switch
description: The Materialize lever switch with optional Off/On text, built on an accessible switch role.
improvements: Exposed as role=switch with aria-checked; Space and Enter toggle it.
The Off/On text is decorative, so screen readers announce the real label and state instead of reading Off On.
Focus and press halos match Materialize, and the focus halo only shows for keyboard focus.
Works in native forms (name/value) and supports controlled or uncontrolled checked state.
Transitions are turned off when the user prefers reduced motion; colors follow dark mode.
